name: Proton Picker
tagline: The right Proton build for every game, chosen at launch.
description: Steam normally applies one global Proton choice or forces you to edit a per-game setting. Proton Picker sits at the launch point, reads the app ID, and starts a pinned build, a strongly supported build, or the newest installed official Proton. It keeps working when a games drive disappears.
requirements: Linux desktop Steam (Steam Deck/Decky and Flatpak Steam are not yet validated)
At least one Proton build installed in Steam
before: At least one Proton version installed in Steam
Steam closed before you run setup

steps.title: Download the alpha
steps.text: Get the Linux archive from itch.io or GitHub. Keep the extracted folder somewhere you can find it.

steps.title: Run the setup once
steps.text: With Steam closed, run install.sh in the folder. Setup backs up your Steam config before changing anything. This is the step a one-click installer will replace next.

steps.title: Restart Steam and play
steps.text: Open Steam again and press Play as usual. Proton Picker routes each game to the chosen Proton build.

faq.a: Yes. The alpha is free; donations are optional.
No. It changes which Proton build Steam launches and backs up Steam's config before editing it.

faq.q: Does it work on Steam Deck?
faq.a: Not validated yet. A read-only Decky status panel exists for sideload testing, but it has not run on a physical Deck; use desktop Steam for the supported alpha setup.
Run uninstall.py with Steam closed. It restores your previous global choice and any per-game overrides removed during setup.

limits: Steam's launch handoff is verified, but a full session into gameplay was not completed.
Recommendations depend on one public report mirror; sparse coverage falls back to the newest official Proton.
The updater only routes to Proton builds that are already installed.
Removing per-game overrides is recorded and restorable, but backups are still your responsibility.

aur.label: Arch / AUR
aur.note: Recipe is prepared but not published yet. It will verify and install the official archive, not mirror it.

itch.label: itch.io
itch.note: Direct download from the Brlinkin page.

decky.label: Steam Deck (sideload)
decky.note: Read-only status panel for Decky. Unvalidated on SteamOS; install the ZIP in Decky Developer mode.

checks: Stop hunting through Steam Play settings for every game.
Pin a build per game without creating Steam overrides.
Survive missing builds and unmounted game drives.
Remove stale per-game overrides with a backup and restore path.

problems_cards.title: Why does Steam use the same Proton version for every game?
problems_cards.text: How the picker replaces the global choice and routes each app ID at launch.

problems_cards.title: Why do my Steam per-game Proton overrides disappear?
problems_cards.text: Steam rewrites its config. Keep pins outside Steam and restore removed mappings later.

problems_cards.title: Why did my game stop launching after a drive was unmounted?
problems_cards.text: Ranked fallbacks and a last-resort scan instead of one hard-coded Proton path.
